name: Cross-Body Dual Cable Lat Pulldown
description: The cross-body dual cable pulldown uses both sides of a functional trainer simultaneously, with each hand pulling the opposite cable downward in a crossing motion. This arrangement places the lats under constant tension through a rotational arc and challenges the core's rotational stability. The crossed cable path provides a unique contraction angle not replicable with straight-down pulldown machines.

execution.starting_position: Set both pulleys on a dual cable machine to the highest position. Attach single handles to each. Stand in the center and reach up to grip the handles — right hand grips the left cable, left hand grips the right cable.
execution.setup_instructions: Set both sides to equal weight. Stand centered between the cable columns with arms crossed and extended overhead.
steps: Step 1: Stand between the cable columns holding crossed handles, arms fully extended overhead.
Step 2: Brace the core and maintain a slight forward lean.
Step 3: Simultaneously pull both handles downward and inward, drawing the elbows to the sides of the torso.
Step 4: At the bottom, hands finish near the hips with lats fully contracted.
Step 5: Slowly return both arms to the overhead crossed start position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the pull, inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Using momentum or rocking to initiate the pull
Not controlling the return phase, losing lat engagement
safety_considerations: Start with light weight to learn the coordination pattern
Ensure both cable sides are set to equal weights
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full overhead extension at the start to arms at sides with lats contracted at the finish.
coaching_cues: Squeeze lats hard at the bottom
